prerequisites: Having passed at least 150 ECTS credits, including the 60 basic training credits of the Study Plan.
Must enroll in External Internships and all remaining compulsory credits to complete the Degree.
Maximum of 12 optional ECTS credits remaining to finish the degree to present and defend the TFG (qualification requirement).

Must have passed all compulsory subjects for the TFG defense (including the External Internships subject), i.e., must have passed 216 ECTS credits corresponding to basic training, compulsory, and external internship subjects.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to apply the degree's own competencies in an integrated manner.
Ability to write a technical report.
Ability to give a public presentation.
Express technical information in a foreign language, both in writing and orally.
Ability to work autonomously and show initiative.

syllabus_topics: Problem solving in the field of engineering and architecture
Work derived from experience gained in external internships, provided it does not overlap with material presented for evaluating these internships
teaching_methods: Advanced informational skills course for TFG elaboration, in collaboration with the ULL Library.
Practical classes in the classroom for medium or full groups
Seminars or other complementary activities for full or small groups
Attendance at tutorials, in-person and/or virtual, for small groups
Presentation and defense of the final course project

assessment_methods.method: TFG document evaluation reports issued by the tribunal members

assessment_rules: The final grade will be the weighted average of the numerical grades obtained in each part. If a student has not completed the 'Advanced informational skills' course, their final grade will be penalized by 5%. Likewise, anyone who does not include the abstract and conclusions in English in the TFG Report and/or does not perform the corresponding part in English in the oral presentation will be penalized by 20% of the final grade. For the award of 'Matrícula de Honor' (Distinction), a grade of 10.0 must have been obtained.
